content:
First Half: Wildlife biologist, cryptozoologist, and TV host Pat Spain will recount his adventures investigating cryptids and unexplained phenomena in some of the world’s most remote locations. He’ll share details of strange encounters, unexpected discoveries, and behind-the-scenes stories that never made it to air, while exploring mysteries that continue to challenge our understanding of the natural world.

Second Half: Metaphysician, medium, and shaman Ellie Pechet will discuss her belief that earthbound spirits can attach themselves to the living, potentially contributing to unexplained emotional, physical, and behavioral changes. She’ll share accounts from her work detaching spirits from individuals, clearing haunted homes and businesses, and helping earthbound spirits move on.
